6 Months - 1 years of experience in Technical Support, Application Support, Production Support.
Experience in monitoring production applications, transactions, and resolving operational issues.
Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix commands and troubleshooting.
Hands on experience working with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or TiDB, including data extraction and validation.
Understanding of web applications, APIs, payment processing systems, and transaction flows.
Hands-on experience with ticketing and incident management tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams, stakeholders, and merchants.
Skills and Experience:
Good knowledge of Linux command-line operations, log analysis, and server troubleshooting.
Hands on experience working with MySQL, MongoDB, and TiDB databases, including data extraction, validation, and troubleshooting.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and other spreadsheet functions.
Familiarity with AI-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, and similar productivity tools for analysis, documentation, and troubleshooting.

Lock Desk Analyst – U.S. Mortgage
Job Description: Lock Desk Analyst – U.S. Mortgage
Job Summary
The Lock Desk Analyst manages mortgage rate lock requests, pricing, lock changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations according to company policies, investor guidelines, and market pricing. The role involves coordinating with Loan Officers (LOs), Loan Processors (LPs), Secondary Marketing, underwriting, and investors to ensure accurate pricing, timely lock execution, and compliance with established procedures. The analyst also reviews daily investor rate sheets, maintains pricing accuracy in mortgage systems, investigates and resolves pricing discrepancies, and supports the smooth functioning of the mortgage lock desk.
Key Responsibilities
1. Mortgage Rate Lock Management:
Process rate lock requests from Loan Officers (LOs) and Loan Processors (LPs), verify loan details (amount, program, interest rate, LTV, FICO, occupancy, property type, and lock period), ensure eligibility and compliance with company policies and investor guidelines, and accurately process new locks, changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations on time. Monitor lock expirations, communicate confirmations, rejections, and required corrections, and maintain accurate records in the loan origination system.
2. Mortgage Pricing and Rate Sheet Management:
Download and review daily investor rate sheets for dates, pricing adjustments, product availability, and lock periods. Upload and maintain rate sheets and pricing data in the pricing engine. Compare investor pricing with internal systems to identify differences. Review base pricing, loan-level price adjustments (LLPAs), margins, concessions, discount points, and lender credits. Calculate and verify final borrower or broker pricing according to company policies. Provide accurate pricing information to Loan Officers for eligible loan scenarios.
3. Lock Extensions, Relocks, and Pricing Exceptions:
Review and process lock extensions, relocks, and pricing exceptions according to company policies. Calculate extension fees, relock fees, and pricing adjustments. Check lock history, expiration dates, previous extensions, and available free extension days. Process pricing concessions and exceptions only after obtaining the required approvals. Verify approval authority and maintain supporting documents. Communicate applicable fees, pricing impacts, and processing restrictions to the requesting teams.
4. Investor Guidelines and Product Eligibility:
Review investor guidelines and product eligibility before processing lock requests. Verify delegated and non-delegated lending channels, where applicable. Confirm product availability based on loan program, credit score, occupancy, LTV, loan purpose, and other applicable criteria. Identify investor-specific restrictions and escalate exceptions when needed. Coordinate with investor representatives to resolve pricing, eligibility, and lock-related issues. Ensure all pricing and lock activities follow investor requirements and internal policies.
5. Communication and Issue Resolution:
Respond to inquiries from Loan Officers, Loan Processors, Secondary Marketing, and other internal teams. Explain pricing differences, lock rejections, extension fees, and investor restrictions clearly. Follow up on pending lock requests, pricing exceptions, and unresolved system issues. Escalate complex pricing and eligibility concerns to the appropriate manager or authorized approver. Maintain professional communication and meet established service-level agreements (SLAs).
6. Quality Control and Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of lock requests, confirmations, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and pricing exceptions. Check loan details and pricing for accuracy. Prepare daily or periodic reports on lock activity, expiring locks, pending requests, and pricing issues. Follow internal controls, audit requirements, and documentation standards.
Required Qualifications
A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
At least 1 year of experience in U.S. mortgage operations, Secondary Marketing, or mortgage rate lock desk operations is preferred.
Knowledge of mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and applicable Non-QM products is required, along with Excel, Microsoft Office, and pricing analysis skills.
Strong analytical, numerical, problem-solving, and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests under tight deadlines are essential.
Key Competencies & Performance Metrics
Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
Accuracy in mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, and relocks.
Good time management, prioritization, and attention to detail.
Effective communication, teamwork, and knowledge of investor guidelines and compliance requirements.
Timely processing of lock requests, quick resolution of pricing issues, and adherence to company policies and service-level agreements (SLAs).
Accurate documentation, audit readiness, and reduction of processing errors.

Reporting to our Managing Director and working hand in hand with our CGO and Strategic Business Director, you will own the pipeline, drive every opportunity to its next step, and keep our sales process disciplined from first enquiry to signed agreement. You will also carry a monthly target for qualified meetings booked. This is a step up from a coordination role. Inbound Lead Response & Qualification

Discovery & Sales Meeting Support

Enterprise Selling Support

Coordinate IT and security questionnaires, supplier onboarding forms and procurement steps with the CTO
Prepare RFI/RFP responses and tender documents with the Technical BA
Maintain mutual action plans with customers: agreed steps, owners and dates to signature
Help build business cases and ROI summaries using customer data and LTS case studies
Capture competitor mentions and objections, and keep battlecards current with Marketing
Pipeline Ownership & Next-Step Discipline
Own the pipeline as the single source of truth: every opportunity has a stage, owner, value, next action and date
Chase overdue next steps across the team and escalate stalled deals early
Track POCs and trials against agreed success criteria, end dates and decision meetings
Flag risks: single-threaded deals, missing decision-makers and slipping close dates
Support monthly pipeline forecasting (commit, best case, pipeline) for the Managing Director
CRM, Data & Reporting
Keep HubSpot accurate and complete
Publish the Daily Sales Huddle report (Mon–Fri, exception-based) and the Friday weekly KPI bowler
Prepare the pipeline pack for the weekly Sales Update meeting and track agreed actions to closure
Keep Fireflies notes, SharePoint proposal folders and customer documents organised
Proposal & Commercial Administration
Build proposal decks, POC charters and Documents of Understanding with the Technical BA
Prepare pricing drafts for Director approval, including Change Requests
Send all agreements through DocuSign; track signatures, expiry, POs and first invoices to closure
Handover, Renewals & Expansion
Hand closed deals cleanly to the Technical BA and Customer Success, with a written handover
Track renewals and multi-site rollout opportunities in existing accounts
Spot expansion signals (new sites, modules, users) in customer and project conversations and log them as opportunities
Process Improvement
Apply the LTS sales playbook and collateral pack consistently, and feed back what works with customers
Suggest and run improvements to templates, sequences, reports and CRM workflows

Job Title: Database Administrator / Engineer (Multi-Platform)
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and adaptable Database Administrator / Engineer to manage, optimize, and secure our core database infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for the health, performance, and scaling of our multi-platform database environment, which includes PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Oracle systems.
The ideal candidate has hands-on technical proficiency across both modern open-source relational setups (PostgreSQL and MySQL) and traditional enterprise systems (Oracle), ensuring high availability, reliable backups, and efficient query performance.
Key Responsibilities
Database Administration: Install, configure, patch, and maintain PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Oracle database instances across production and non-production environments.
Performance Tuning: Proactively monitor system metrics to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks. Assist development teams with query optimization, indexing strategies, and schema design.
Backup & Disaster Recovery: Implement, maintain, and regularly test robust backup and recovery strategies to prevent data loss and ensure business continuity.
Replication & High Availability: Manage database replication, clustering, and failover mechanisms (e.g., PostgreSQL streaming replication, MySQL replication, Oracle Data Guard).
Security & Access Control: Enforce database security policies, manage user permissions, and ensure data encryption at rest and in transit.
Automation: Write and maintain automation scripts (using Shell, Python, or PowerShell) for routine maintenance, deployments, and health monitoring.
Troubleshooting: Provide timely resolution for database alerts, connectivity issues, and performance degradation tickets.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Experience: Minimum 4 years of professional experience in relational database administration (RDBMS) within a production environment, with active hands-on exposure to all three platforms.
Core Technical Competencies:
PostgreSQL: Practical knowledge of PostgreSQL architecture, configuration, vacuum processes, and replication setups.
MySQL: Solid understanding of MySQL storage engines, replication types, and configuration tuning.
Oracle: Hands-on experience with Oracle database management, including architecture basics, backup/recovery utilities (RMAN), and Data Guard.
SQL Proficiency: Strong command of standard SQL alongside procedural languages (PL/pgSQL, PL/SQL).
OS & Infrastructure: Solid working knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems, commanding basic administration and shell scripting.
Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with cloud database solutions (e.g., AWS RDS, Azure SQL, or GCP Cloud SQL).
Basic exposure to database migration tools and cross-platform data syncing.
Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Oracle Certified Associate, PostgreSQL or MySQL Administrator tracks).

job_description:
About
NeedStreet builds the ContinuousCare cloud platform that healthcare organisations use to deliver care online. Healthcare businesses run their own branded patient experience on our multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform. The services we run are critical to patient care, so we treat security, privacy and reliability as core product features.
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior AWS DevOps Engineer to own the reliability, security, and delivery of our B2B SaaS platform on AWS. You will be responsible for cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, container platforms, observability, and security compliance, and you will work closely with application engineering teams.
Responsibilities
Cloud Infrastructure (AWS)
• Operate and secure production infrastructure across EC2, VPC, ALB, WAF, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, ECR, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Athena, and Secrets Manager / SSM.
• Manage networking, edge routing, web application firewall rules, and TLS/certificate lifecycle.
• Carry out capacity planning, performance tuning, and cost optimisation.
• Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery procedures and testing.
Infrastructure as Code
• Design and maintain Terraform modules, state, and environment configuration.
• Run infrastructure changes through code review and CI, and handle configuration drift.
Kubernetes & Containers
• Design, provision, and operate Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and workloads.
• Build and maintain secure, efficient container images and runtime configurations.
CI/CD
• Own build, test, and release pipelines (GitHub Actions), including artifact versioning, environment promotion, approvals, and rollback.
• Integrate security scanning (images, dependencies, secrets, IaC) into delivery pipelines.
Platform Services
• Operate and tune Redis, RabbitMQ, MySQL, Keycloak (OIDC/OAuth2), and Apache/nginx reverse proxies.
• Support the deployment and runtime operation of Java (Spring Boot / Spring Cloud) and Node.js services.
Security & Compliance
• Apply least-privilege access, secrets management, encryption, network segmentation, and system hardening.
• Support compliance programmes (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, GDPR) through audit evidence, access reviews, logging and retention, change management, and vulnerability management.
• Lead incident response and post-incident reviews.
Observability
• Maintain metrics, logging, and alerting with Prometheus/Grafana, Loki, CloudWatch, and OpenSearch/Kibana.
• Write and maintain runbooks and operational documentation.
Automation & AI
• Automate operational tasks with Bash, Python, and/or PowerShell and the AWS CLI/SDKs.
• Use AI-assisted tools responsibly, in line with data protection and security policies.
Collaboration
• Act as a technical point of reference on infrastructure and delivery practices, and mentor other engineers.
Required Qualifications
Candidates must have hands-on production experience in each of the areas below.
• 6+ years in DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure engineering, including 4+ years running production workloads on AWS.
• Terraform at production scale: module design, remote state across multiple environments, CI-driven plan/apply, and drift and state management.
• Kubernetes in production, preferably EKS: cluster provisioning with Terraform, Helm/Kustomize, ingress, autoscaling, RBAC, network policies, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
• Ownership of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred).
• Deep Docker expertise, including multi-stage builds and image hardening.
• Production operation of Redis, RabbitMQ, and MySQL.
• Apache and nginx as reverse proxies.
• Operating JVM (Spring Boot / Spring Cloud) and Node.js services in production.
• Keycloak or a comparable OIDC/OAuth2 identity platform, from an operations perspective.
• Prometheus/Grafana, Loki, and OpenSearch/Kibana.
• Security-first engineering: IAM design, secrets management, encryption, audit logging, and vulnerability management.
• Experience supporting compliance audits (SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, or similar), ideally in healthcare or another regulated-industry SaaS.
• Strong scripting in Bash plus Python or PowerShell.
• Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools with appropriate security controls.
• Clear written and verbal communication.

3. Behaviour Change & Intervention – Behavioural Science
Help design and implement persona-specific interventions to improve AI adoption.
Support experiments and practical initiatives that encourage consistent AI usage.
Track behavioural changes over time using observations, feedback and usage data.
Compare outcomes before and after interventions and recommend improvements based on the findings.
4. Research-to-Action & Reporting
Convert observations into clear hypotheses that can be tested using data.
Support the implementation of research findings
Document results, identify what works and what does not, and communicate clear, decision-ready conclusions.
Refine approaches when evidence shows that an intervention is not effective.

We are seeking an experienced NOC / SRE Lead to own the health, observability, and incident response for a connected fleet of field-deployed systems and the data center infrastructure that supports it.
This is the keystone L3 role in our Network Operations Center (NOC). You will own deep diagnosis and root-cause analysis on the running system, command the hardest escalations, and build the standards, runbooks, observability architecture, and operator-certification program that the rest of the NOC inherits.
As the L3 Lead, you will act as the escalation point above L2 support teams, taking ownership of the most complex incidents while keeping escalations to L4 product engineering limited to genuine code and firmware issues — protecting both fleet uptime and engineering velocity.
This is a greenfield opportunity. In the near term, the role combines a hands-on L3 technical function with NOC leadership. As the NOC scales, the role is designed to grow into a Principal SRE or NOC Manager track.
Key Responsibilities
1. Fleet Health & Observability
Architect the monitoring stack the NOC runs on — scrape architecture, alert rules, dashboards, and SLOs — rather than only consuming it.
Own end-to-end visibility of the connected fleet across data center, edge Kubernetes, Linux, and network layers.
Continuously tune alerting to reduce noise and catch degradation early.
2. Data Center & Infrastructure Operations

Manage hardware fault handling, RMA workflows, and site-level incident response across distributed data center and edge sites.
Coordinate with telecommunications providers, colocation partners, cloud vendors, and infrastructure service providers to resolve service-impacting issues and maintain operational continuity.

Diagnose complex issues across:

Production Kubernetes and Linux platform dependencies at the edge
Assume end-to-end ownership of major incidents, service disruptions, and customer escalations until resolution and formal closure.

Own the operator-certification layer that qualifies operators to run and support the fleet.
Develop and continuously improve runbooks and operational procedures inherited by L1/L2 teams.

Facilitate technical communication across engineering and operations teams during major incidents, providing timely stakeholder updates.

job_description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Assistant Manager – Procurement & Supply Chain to manage domestic and international procurement of electronic components, modules, IT hardware, networking products, software licences, surveillance equipment and other technology-related products.
The role covers the complete procurement lifecycle—from requirement and BOM review to vendor selection, negotiation, purchase order, import coordination, delivery and supplier-performance management.
Key Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end procurement from purchase requisition to material receipt and order closure.
Review BOMs, technical specifications, configurations, OEM part numbers and project requirements with Engineering, IT, Production and Project teams.
Source products through OEMs, authorised distributors, system integrators, manufacturers and qualified domestic and international suppliers.
Obtain quotations, prepare technical-commercial comparisons and negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery, warranty, SLA, AMC and replacement terms.
Evaluate purchases based on total cost of ownership, technical compatibility, product lifecycle, support availability and delivery risk.
Prepare Purchase Orders and follow up on order confirmation, availability, dispatch, shipment and delivery.
Calculate landed cost, including currency, freight, insurance, customs duty, taxes and handling charges.
Coordinate international procurement with suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, Finance and Stores.
Verify component authenticity, product specifications, licences, warranty, traceability and applicable compliance requirements.
Monitor lead times, MOQ, allocation, NCNR conditions, component shortages, product discontinuation and obsolescence risks.
Develop alternate vendors, dual-source strategies, local sourcing and import-substitution opportunities.
Plan purchases based on project schedules, production forecasts, IT requirements, inventory levels and safety-stock requirements.
Track software subscriptions, licence renewals, warranties, AMCs and support-contract expiry dates.
Evaluate supplier performance based on quality, cost, delivery, technical support and after-sales service.
Coordinate incoming inspection, installation support, rejected-material replacement, warranty claims and RMA activities.
Maintain vendor databases, price history, purchase records, approved supplier lists and procurement documentation.
Prepare periodic reports on pending POs, shortages, supplier status, cost savings, imports and supply-chain risks.
Procurement Categories
Electronics and Technology Components
Semiconductors, ICs, processors and microcontrollers
System-on-Modules, Single-Board Computers and AI/edge-computing modules
Image sensors, camera modules, lenses and illuminators
PCBs, PCBAs, memory, storage and communication modules
Power supplies, batteries, converters, connectors, cables and sensors
CCTV, NVR/DVR, IoT, embedded and industrial technology products
IT Hardware and Infrastructure
Servers, GPU servers, workstations, desktops and laptops
Storage systems, NAS/SAN devices, SSDs and backup equipment
Routers, switches, firewalls, access points and communication devices
Racks, UPS systems, monitors, printers and IT peripherals
Data-centre and networking accessories
OEM spares, upgrades, warranties and annual maintenance contracts
Software and IT Services
Operating systems and enterprise software licences
Cybersecurity, backup and productivity software
Development tools and database licences
Cloud, SaaS and subscription-based services
Technical support, implementation and managed-service contracts
preferred_skills:
Strong vendor sourcing, negotiation and supplier-management skills.
Ability to understand BOMs, datasheets, IT configurations and OEM part numbers.
Knowledge of authorised electronics and IT distribution channels.
Understanding of international procurement, Incoterms, import documentation and landed-cost calculation.
Familiarity with IT licensing, warranties, SLAs, AMCs and subscription renewals.
Ability to evaluate pricing, technical compliance, compatibility, quality and total cost of ownership.
Good analytical, documentation, follow-up and cross-functional coordination skills.

Minimum 4–5 years of relevant procurement or sourcing experience.
Hands-on experience in vendor development, quotation analysis, negotiation, PO processing and supplier follow-up is required.
Experience in electronics, IT infrastructure, networking, software licensing, CCTV, IoT or embedded-product procurement is preferred.
Exposure to international sourcing, imports and logistics coordination will be an added advantage.

Procurement cost savings and total-cost optimisation

Supplier quality and delivery performance

job_description:
About the role
We are seeking a qualified capital/finance professional to lead the capital and control workstream for new regulated insurance entities established by the Group — including DFSA, Cayman and Lloyd’s structures. The primary focus of the role is on new entity establishment: defining the capital structure, building the financial control framework, and establishing the regulatory reporting infrastructure from inception. Once entities are operational, you will support their ongoing financial and regulatory requirements as needed, alongside supporting existing entities and reinsurance programmes where required. You will also supervise a junior analyst. This is a build-focused role for someone comfortable standing things up from scratch, not just running steady-state reporting.
Key responsibilities
Lead the financial establishment of new regulated entities (DFSA, Cayman, Lloyd’s and others) — defining the opening balance sheet, capital structure and financial control framework from inception, and ensuring each entity is correctly capitalised and controlled before it writes business.
Build capital adequacy and solvency models for each new entity to meet the requirements of the relevant regulator; maintain and update these models as the entity grows.
Establish the regulatory reporting framework for each new jurisdiction (e.g. DFSA, Cayman, Lloyd’s), including designing the reporting pack, setting the reporting calendar and producing the first returns; hand over to ongoing support once embedded.
Build the financial model for each new entity — three-statement model and entity-level profit and loss — establishing the management reporting suite from which ongoing reporting will run.
Establish the reinsurance programme accounting structure for new entities (quota share, excess of loss, ceding commission), ensuring the accounting treatment and control framework are correctly set up from inception; support existing programmes as required.
Produce the first monthly management accounts and entity-level reporting pack for each new entity, establishing the format, commentary structure and distribution; support the ongoing production of these for existing entities as required.
Reconcile intercompany balances and positions across group entities.
Manage the Group’s Funds at Lloyd’s (FAL) position for the Syndicate in a Box (SIAB) — providing feeds to C&C’s selected managing agent for completion of the annual capital setting process (ECM/SBF cycle), optimising FAL composition across cash, LOCs and approved investments, responding to Lloyd’s capital calls, and maintaining the FAL headroom analysis relative to the approved capital requirement.
Run capital adequacy stress testing and scenario analysis across the Group’s regulated entities — including shock loss, premium volume growth and FX sensitivity — to assess headroom above SCR/MCR thresholds and inform capital deployment decisions.
Manage collateral arrangements supporting the Group’s reinsurance programmes — including letters of credit, trust accounts and cash deposits — ensuring collateral is correctly sized, documented and renewed in line with programme terms and regulatory requirements.
Own the capital waterfall and inter-entity funding mechanics — managing dividend upstream, shareholder loan repayment and capital repatriation between regulated entities and the parent, and ensuring all movements are within approved limits and correctly documented.
Track and report reinsurance counterparty credit exposure across the Group’s programmes, maintaining the counterparty register and flagging rating changes, concentration risk or collateral shortfalls.
Produce the board-level capital reporting pack — including capital dashboard, solvency headroom by entity, FAL position and stress test outcomes — on a quarterly basis or as required by the board or managing agent.
Support existing entities and reinsurance programmes as required, including covering financial control, reporting or capital queries where capacity or expertise is needed.
Supervise and direct the Capital & Structuring Analyst on day-to-day work.
preferred_skills:
Qualified or finalist accountant (ACCA, CIMA, ACA or equivalent).
Experience with capital adequacy and solvency reporting, regulatory returns, and capital stress testing within an insurance or reinsurance context; familiarity with SCR/MCR frameworks across more than one jurisdiction is an advantage.
Hands-on financial modelling experience, ideally within insurance or reinsurance.
Understanding of reinsurance accounting (quota share, excess of loss, ceding commission) and collateral management arrangements (letters of credit, trust accounts) supporting reinsurance programmes.
Demonstrable experience setting up the financial and reporting infrastructure for regulated entities in one or more of: DFSA/DIFC, Cayman Islands, Lloyd’s of London. Familiarity with Lloyd’s capital processes — including FAL management, the ECM/SBF annual cycle and Syndicate in a Box (SIAB) structures — is a strong advantage. Experience across more than one jurisdiction is preferred.
Strong accounting software skills (Xero) and advanced Excel / modelling ability.
Comfortable working independently.

job_description:
ECS Fin is an engineering enterprise that specializes in process optimization. Our software solutions which include an enterprise messaging management system, a SWIFT certified transaction processing system, a post trade processing application and a treasury management system are used by different Financial Institutions and Corporates all over the world.
We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer with expertise in Kubernetes management to join our team. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and processes required to deploy and manage applications on Kubernetes clusters. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, system administrators, and quality assurance, to ensure smooth and efficient operations in a cloud-native environment.
Experience Level: 2 to 5 years
Key Responsibilities:
Kubernetes Infrastructure Management: Design, deploy, configure, and maintain Kubernetes clusters to ensure high availability, scalability, and performance. Manage and automate cluster provisioning, upgrades, and monitoring.
Deployment and Release Management: Develop CI/CD pipelines and automation scripts to enable seamless application deployments on Kubernetes. Implement rolling updates, blue-green deployments, and canary releases. Ensure smooth coordination between development, testing, and production environments.
Monitoring and Performance Optimization: Set up monitoring and logging solutions to gain visibility into the Kubernetes clusters and deployed applications. Monitor resource utilization, identify bottlenecks, and optimize performance. Implement auto-scaling mechanisms to handle varying workloads.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize tools like Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies to define infrastructure configurations and automate infrastructure provisioning. Maintain version-controlled infrastructure code for reproducibility and scalability.
Troubleshooting and Incident Management: Diagnose and resolve issues related to Kubernetes infrastructure, networking, and application deployments.
Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles related to Kubernetes management. Share knowledge and provide guidance to teammates on Kubernetes best practices and troubleshooting techniques.
preferred_skills:
Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer, specifically in managing Kubernetes clusters.
In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes architecture, components, and best practices.
Proficiency in containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and container orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm).
Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and related tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD).
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their managed Kubernetes services.
Solid scripting and automation skills (e.g., Bash, Python, PowerShell).
Understanding of networking concepts, load balancers, and DNS management in Kubernetes.
Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
